actions.convert_file.description: Convert an uploaded file or a public file URL to PDF. The engine is chosen automatically from the extension — Office (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX…), images, HTML, Markdown, or PDF passthrough.
actions.convert_file.props.nativePageRan: Limit output to specific pages, e.g. "1-3" or "2,5-7".
actions.convert_file.props.ownerPassword: Restrict editing/printing of the resulting PDF.
actions.convert_file.props.password.desc: Password to open a protected source document (office files only).
actions.convert_file.props.source.descri: Convert an uploaded file or a public file URL.
Encrypt the resulting PDF; this password is required to open it.
actions.convert_html.description: Render a raw HTML string (with optional CSS) to PDF using Chromium.
actions.convert_html.props.css.descripti: Optional CSS, injected into the document head.
actions.convert_html.props.nativePageRan: Limit output to specific pages, e.g. "1-3" or "2,5-7".
actions.convert_html.props.ownerPassword: Restrict editing/printing of the resulting PDF.
actions.convert_html.props.scale.descrip: Render scale, e.g. 0.8 to shrink content. Default 1.
Encrypt the resulting PDF; this password is required to open it.
actions.convert_markdown.description: Render a raw Markdown string (with optional CSS) to PDF. A sensible default stylesheet is applied when no CSS is provided.
actions.convert_markdown.props.css.descr: Optional CSS to style the rendered Markdown. Overrides the default stylesheet.
actions.convert_markdown.props.nativePag: Limit output to specific pages, e.g. "1-3" or "2,5-7".
actions.convert_markdown.props.ownerPass: Restrict editing/printing of the resulting PDF.
actions.convert_markdown.props.scale.des: Render scale, e.g. 0.8 to shrink content. Default 1.
actions.convert_markdown.props.userPassw: Encrypt the resulting PDF; this password is required to open it.
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.descripti: Convert a document, spreadsheet, presentation or image to a PDF file.
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.add: Other FileToPDF conversion parameters as a JSON object of name to value, e.g. {"metadata": {"Title": "Report"}}. Supported here: nativeWatermarkText, quality (1-100), losslessImageCompression, reduceImageResolution, maxImageResolution (DPI), flatten, metadata (Author, Title, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer, CreationDate, ModDate), singlePageSheets, exportFormFields, exportNotes, exportNotesPages, exportHiddenSlides, skipEmptyPages, addOriginalDocumentAsStream, displayPDFDocumentTitle. The fields above win over the same name here.
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.fil: The file to convert: a URL to it or a file from an earlier step. Its name must end with the real extension (e.g. .docx), which picks the converter.
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.lan: Rotate the output to landscape. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.nat: Pages to keep, counted from 1, always written as ranges: "1-1" for page 1 alone, "1-3" for pages 1 to 3. A bare "1" is ignored and every page is kept. Omit for all pages.
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.own: Password that controls printing, copying and editing of the PDF.
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.pas: Password that opens a protected source document (Office files only).
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.pdf: Produce an archival PDF: "PDF/A-1b", "PDF/A-2b" or "PDF/A-3b". Cannot be combined with userPassword or ownerPassword.
Apply PDF/UA accessibility post-processing. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
actions.filetopdf_convert_file.props.use: Encrypt the PDF so this password is needed to open it. Cannot be combined with pdfa.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.descripti: Render an HTML string to a PDF file with Chromium.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.add: Other FileToPDF conversion parameters as a JSON object of name to value, e.g. {"metadata": {"Title": "Report"}}. Supported here: waitDelay ("500ms", max "15s"), waitForSelector, waitForExpression, emulatedMediaType ("print" or "screen"), emulatedMediaFeatures, singlePage, omitBackground, generateDocumentOutline, generateTaggedPdf, flatten, metadata (Author, Title, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer, CreationDate, ModDate), skipNetworkIdleEvent, failOnConsoleExceptions, failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes, extraHttpHeaders, userAgent. The fields above win over the same name here.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.css: CSS injected as a <style> block into the document head. Omit if the HTML carries its own styles.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.htm: The HTML to render. Images, fonts and CSS must load from public URLs.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.lan: Rotate the output to landscape. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.nat: Pages to keep, counted from 1, e.g. "1-3" or "1,3,5-7". Omit for all pages.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.own: Password that controls printing, copying and editing of the PDF.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.pap: Page height in inches. Defaults to 11 (US Letter); A4 is 11.69.
Page width in inches. Defaults to 8.5 (US Letter); A4 is 8.27.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.pdf: Produce an archival PDF: "PDF/A-1b", "PDF/A-2b" or "PDF/A-3b". Cannot be combined with userPassword or ownerPassword.
Apply PDF/UA accessibility post-processing. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.pre: Take the page size from the CSS @page rule instead of paperWidth and paperHeight. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.pri: Keep CSS background colors and images. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.sca: Content scale from 0.1 to 2. Defaults to 1; below 1 shrinks the content.
actions.filetopdf_convert_html.props.use: Encrypt the PDF so this password is needed to open it. Cannot be combined with pdfa.
actions.filetopdf_convert_markdown.descr: Render a Markdown string to a styled PDF file.
actions.filetopdf_convert_markdown.props: Other FileToPDF conversion parameters as a JSON object of name to value, e.g. {"metadata": {"Title": "Report"}}. Supported here: waitDelay ("500ms", max "15s"), waitForSelector, waitForExpression, emulatedMediaType ("print" or "screen"), emulatedMediaFeatures, singlePage, omitBackground, generateDocumentOutline, generateTaggedPdf, flatten, metadata (Author, Title, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer, CreationDate, ModDate), skipNetworkIdleEvent, failOnConsoleExceptions, failOnResourceHttpStatusCodes, extraHttpHeaders, userAgent. The fields above win over the same name here.
CSS that replaces the default stylesheet. Omit to keep the default styling.
Rotate the output to landscape. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
The Markdown to render (GitHub Flavored Markdown). Images must load from public URLs.
Pages to keep, counted from 1, e.g. "1-3" or "1,3,5-7". Omit for all pages.
Password that controls printing, copying and editing of the PDF.
Page height in inches. Defaults to 11 (US Letter); A4 is 11.69.
Page width in inches. Defaults to 8.5 (US Letter); A4 is 8.27.
Produce an archival PDF: "PDF/A-1b", "PDF/A-2b" or "PDF/A-3b". Cannot be combined with userPassword or ownerPassword.
Apply PDF/UA accessibility post-processing. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
Take the page size from the CSS @page rule instead of paperWidth and paperHeight. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
Keep CSS background colors and images. "true" or "false"; omit to use the default (false).
Content scale from 0.1 to 2. Defaults to 1; below 1 shrinks the content.
Encrypt the PDF so this password is needed to open it. Cannot be combined with pdfa.

auth.description:
Your FileToPDF API key (format `sk_live_...`).

Get one in seconds: open [filetopdf.dev](https://filetopdf.dev) and click **Get a free API key** on the home page for an instant trial key (no account, 10 free conversions), or create one in the [dashboard](https://filetopdf.dev).
description: Convert files, HTML, and Markdown to PDF. Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX), images, web pages, and Markdown become clean PDFs over a simple API.
